status: Detailed STE-style operating manual; existing GCaMP6f-expressing HEK293 and available Gibco DMEM; proposed device/material tests, no completed experiment or formal ASD-STE100 certification
engineering_choices_not_manufacturer_pro: PBS approximately pH 7.4; provisional 80 uL per well only after actual capacity/leak check; C=0.10 uM and half C=0.05 uM are a proposed starting range
One bounded fallback pilot C=0.50 uM with half C=0.25 uM; restart all formal calibration/series if changed
Nine formal states with five distinct 2-second technical blocks per state (45); an additional five PHASE_REF setup blocks for UI correction; separate dark QC
Relative row-normalized volume-model comparison, not a radiometric calibration or GCaMP concentration conversion
Conditional same-batch cell/reference comparison uses established laboratory controls and a prespecified sustained-response window
Nominal floor area 0.112 cm2; 3000 viable HEK293 cells/well (2.68e4/cm2), or a 1500/3000/4000 pilot; density and attachment must be confirmed in actual printed wells
80 uL at 3000 viable cells/well requires 3.75e4 viable cells/mL; nominal liquid depth 7.14 mm; historical 100 uL models were not rerun
First assessment at 24-48 h after seeding is a planning window, not guaranteed assay readiness; reporter expression timing remains assay-specific
Proposed material gates include healthy morphology and viability at least 80% of matched tissue-culture plastic; no claim of regulatory qualification
Proposed evaporation rework threshold 10%; first external-reader feasibility run 10-15 min; baseline recording 2-5 min; each requires actual temperature/pH and reference controls
Use the existing GCaMP6f-expressing HEK293. HEK293T is not the basis for its DMEM recipe. No new genetic-engineering or stimulus procedure is prescribed.
For HEK293 ATCC CRL-1573, default the 10-15 min device feasibility pilot to externally controlled and verified 37 C; inspect attachment before/after. HEPES does not provide temperature control.
Complete DMEM example: 45.00 mL basal DMEM plus 5.00 mL suitable existing FBS gives 50.00 mL with 10% FBS; already-complete medium is not supplemented again

Glutamine branch: if present as L-glutamine or GlutaMAX, do not add automatically. If absent, follow the existing cell procedure and product instructions. The 0.50 mL of 200 mM example applies only when 2 mM added glutamine is already required.

Standard starting example is 37 C in a humidified 5% CO2 incubator. Different product-label or already-successful cell conditions take precedence. Check equilibrated pH; no immediate EMEM or special imaging-buffer purchase is required.

Current optical comparison uses no filter, one LEE 101 layer, two LEE 101 layers, and one specified OD4 filter; separate calibration/complete sequence for every configuration; no new spectral numerical results in this guide.

English numbered instructions target at most 20 words per sentence; descriptive sentences target at most 25 words. This is a writing-style check, not formal ASD-STE100 vocabulary/compliance certification.

local_evidence.acquisition_boundary: 2-second blocks plus at least 3 seconds idle; carrier frequencies do not imply fast per-well cell time series
local_evidence.volume_model_boundary: Original model_fill_uL=100 remains historical; not rerun or quantitatively matched to the current provisional 80 uL test
local_evidence.offline_matrix_definition: For each single-well condition, abs(mean(blank-corrected complex I/Q)), then row normalization; not signed projection or mean of magnitudes. Low-SNR magnitude bias remains.
local_evidence.phase_reference_workflow: UI PHASE_REF adds five setup blocks after B_CAL and before B_CHECK/sample collection. quick_check.py ignores PHASE_REF and uses formal ALL_C for offline signed projection.
local_evidence.raw_waveform_retention: Only latest raw ADC waveform available: stop and download B_CAL final block before PHASE_REF, and ALL_C final block before ALL_HALF_REPEAT. Final session JSON retains observed I/Q block records, not every raw waveform.
local_evidence.manual_style: Preparation, procedure, checks and failure actions; detailed quantities retained; no formal ASD-STE100 certification

no_claims: No absolute optical power or GCaMP concentration calibration
No gas or protein-assisted uptake validation
No independent biological replication from five technical blocks or four shared-gas wells
